letterhead.note: reference price list letterhead.csv; Size A4 fixed; axes Paper x Print Colour x Packing(Loose/Pad)

folder.note: Folder (Litho). All mould groups. CD Jacket uses averaged prices (an option not exposed in the source price data; median ~1.2% error from averaging). PF/DF/KF groups exact.

pvccard.note: reference price list pvc_card.csv; 86x54mm fixed (orientation/size price-neutral), 0.80mm Gloss PVC, Round Cornering compulsory. Axes: Print Colour(4C Front/Both) x Hole Punch x VDP. Hole Punch + VDP are PRICED (previously quoted-separately).

bunting.note: Bunting (Litho, Tarpaulin 300gsm). Per (size x fitting) qty curve; fitting = Wood/PVC Pipe/Wood+Wire. Synthetic Paper deferred. qty = pcs.

papan_kopi.note: Papan Kopi / Sachet Board exact reference price list. Boxboard Grey Back 400gsm + Gloss Varnish + Die-Cutting compulsory. qty = pcs.

buttonbadge.note: Button Badge (Digital, 58mm round). Lamination (Gloss / Soft Touch) is price-neutral. qty = badges.

handfan.note: Hand Fan (Digital). Per-paper qty curve; price shown at Matte Lamination (Both). qty = fans.

hanger.note: Hanger (Digital). Per-(paper x print colour) qty curve; price shown at Matte Lamination (Both). qty = hangers.

magnet.note: Magnet (Digital, fridge magnet). Per-shape qty curve; price at Matte/Gloss Laminate (Front) (Soft Touch ~+RM4). qty = magnets.

hardmenu.note: Hard Cover Menu (Digital). Per (order type x add-content sheets) qty curve; lamination Gloss/Matte price-neutral. Cover only uses add-content "-". qty = menus.

pouch.note: Standing Pouch (Litho, Metalised Pet Film). Lamination Matte/Gloss price-neutral. Transparent Pet Film pending. qty = pouches.

money_packet.note: Money Packet Standard: Model x Package x Paper x Finishing. Packing Method is price-neutral.

non_woven_bag.note: Non-Woven Bag exact reference price list. Bag Colour / Handle Length / Handle Colour are price-neutral. qty = bags.

tent_card.note: Tent Card exact reference price list. Model TC 003 (294x86mm) / TC 004 (294x140mm). Paper Art Card 310gsm, 4C Front, Die-Cutting+Creasing compulsory. qty = pcs.
